title: Who sent a request to Orange, as Orange's transport saw it (version 1 DRAFT)
description: DRAFT 2026-11-15. Embedded wherever Orange records who asked for an action (first users: orange.empty_background_capture v2 and orange.recording_empty_background v2). It is what the transport observed, never a claim made in the request: a claimed identity (declared_by) is recorded beside it, separately. gui_panel: a button in the Orange GUI; user is the account that started Orange (SUDO_USER under the sudo wrappers, else the real uid's login). local_control_socket: a request on Orange's local-control Unix socket; peer is the kernel's SO_PEERCRED of the connecting process, and a request whose peer the kernel does not report is refused, so peer is never null here. run_spec: an orange_client run that read an experiment spec file; spec_sha256 is of its bytes as read. Same shapes as orange.recording_subject_confirmation v2 requester for gui_panel and local_control_socket.

user.description: Login name of the uid (getpwuid). null means the uid has no passwd entry on the host, not that the sender is unknown: for local_control_socket the sender is identified by peer.uid either way.

peer.description: SO_PEERCRED of the connecting process when the request arrived.

command_source.description: The request's own source field, as sent (a claim; may be empty).

spec_path.description: Provenance only: the spec file's absolute path on the host.

spec_sha256.description: sha256 of the spec file's bytes as orange_client read them (64 lowercase hex).

user.description: The account that ran orange_client (SUDO_USER, else the real uid's login).
